Chore.title: Chore
Chore.description: Represents a user's chore or activity with starting details, time limits, and completion states.

id.description: The unique identifier of the chore document.

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns the chore.

title.description: The title or action statement of the chore.

priority.description: The priority order of the activity task.

limitMinutes.description: Optional time limit for the activity in minutes. Can be null or not set if unlimited.

startTime.description: The timestamp in milliseconds when the chore/activity was added and started.

status.description: The current state of the activity.

createdAt.description: The timestamp in milliseconds indicating when the doc was created.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp in milliseconds indicating when the doc was last updated.

/chores/{choreId}.description: Collections of chores owned by individual authenticated users.
